title: execute_initiatives.json
description: Execute-module initiative list. 5 fields universal, 33 optional. Schema locks only the minimum — adding optional fields is allowed and intentional, but every record MUST have id, name, status, workstream, milestones.
_note: 33 optional fields by design — different initiatives carry different metadata (budget, milestones, sponsor, etc.). Consumers MUST use .get() for any non-required field.
